k2.window_note: no 1 ms valve / stroke recorder on SCM

note: record only, written after the results (2026-11-11)
definition_differences: time base: seconds from result.json t_loop_start_s (closed-loop start after the 8 s gravity settle); V-6 uses settings.start_t_s. Events, phases and the 1 ms series are shifted by the same t0 (t0_s in the row); touch_creep_meta is copied as the controller wrote it (absolute times, as in V-6).

J1 / J2: minimum of the 1 ms step_series.npz F_cyl_N samples (acting force, one sample per 1 ms = 10 physics steps of dt 1e-4 s); V-6 uses the per-physics-step interval minimum pads.npz F_cyl_min_interval. A minimum between two 1 ms samples is not seen (the V-7 value can be higher than the step minimum).

J3 and the latch window: SCM terrain normal force on each pad, step_series.npz scm_pad_normal_N (1 ms); V-6 uses the Chrono contact pad normal of pads.npz (1 ms). Same window (from t_touch_s), threshold (<= 0 N) and latch-window rule (k2_chrono_rows.latch_window_normals).

t_crawler_off_s / t_liftoff_final_s: record/record.npz F_crawler z > 0 at the 10 Hz control instants (first on -> off edge / last on sample + 1, the s6_control._times rule). On soil the SCM crawler normal can stay small and positive after the departure; the P3a-2 departure (normal < 0.01 W for 0.1 s) is given as p3b_departure_s for comparison.
J4: 1 ms step_series.npz roll_pitch_deg minus the controller target (controller_meta.target.target_rad) from the first READY; V-6 uses the record-rate body quaternion.
J6: record/record.npz F_cyl / head area (result meta.actuator.head_area_m2), moving = |u_applied| > 1e-6 m/s, at the 10 Hz record instants (the V-6 rule on the SCM record).
J10 crawler_recontact_after_loc: p3b P3-1_crawler.recontact_count (SCM rule: crawler normal >= 0.01 W after the first departure); V-6 uses s6_control.d8x_metrics after the LOC event.

controller_tag: c2_setup.expect_controller.name, used only when every check of that block is ok (the run refuses to start otherwise); the SCM result.json has no k2.controller_tag. k1_order_gate = c2_setup.k1_order_gate_effective, touch_creep_latch = c2_setup.touch_creep_effective, touch_creep_requested = c2_setup.touch_creep.

floor_true_deg: result.json args floor_roll / floor_pitch; fs_kN: args fs_kN. moving_damping False and pad_zeta_moving None (no moving pad damping on SCM), valve_open_fraction_touch_to_lift None (no pad_damping.npz).
k2 (D_hat): dhat_N = controller_meta.touch_twist_hold.twist_load_estimate_N; no 1 ms valve / stroke recorder on SCM, so the window fields are None (V-6 reads k2_valve.npz).

new V-7 keys (rules 3.6 'sinkage stroke at the latch' per leg): v7_record.latch_legs.<leg> gives the controller creep_travel_m at the latch (stroke travel after touch_seen, controller_meta.touch_creep_latch.latches) and the 1 ms s_motor_m and pad_sinkage_geometric_m at the last sample at or before the latch time; pad_sinkage_geometric_m sign as step_series (positive = pad bottom below the undisturbed soil surface, negative = above it).
